However, the trace shows that the WebSurfer agent only navigated to the page (Turn 10) and did not provide the content confirming the death year. suggested_fix.fix_text: Before asserting specific factual details (like death years) from a webpage, the WebSurfer agent must explicitly scroll to and extract the relevant text snippet, which must then be reported back to the Planner. If the content is not visible in the current viewport or not explicitly retrieved, the agent must indicate 'content not found/verified' rather than hallucinating a value.
